entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Thank you, President Nines.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, President Nines."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Ladies and gentlemen. Leaders of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen. Leaders of the world."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I stand here to hold the Kingdom o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand here to hold the Kingdom of Rizia accountable for the crimes they have committed in Southern Merkopa!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento and I looked at each other..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento and I looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A roar of outrage and confusion ros..."
entries.dialogueText: A roar of outrage and confusion rose in the chamber.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Yes! Rizia is guilty!""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes! Rizia is guilty!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Son of a...""
entries.dialogueText: "Son of a..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just as I expected.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just as I expected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Imagine stooping this low.""
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine stooping this low."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Please calm down, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please calm down, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As befits his position.""
entries.dialogueText: "As befits his position."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Nines hit the gavel."
entries.dialogueText: President Nines hit the gavel.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Guilty of waging a destructive war.""
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty of waging a destructive war."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Guilty of waging a destructive war..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty of waging a destructive war marked by military failure."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Guilty of using deadly experimenta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty of using deadly experimental weapons on the citizens of another country."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Guilty of repeatedly using deadly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty of repeatedly using deadly experimental weapons on the citizens of another country."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Guilty of displacing massive numbe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty of displacing massive numbers of people, causing refugee waves across the continent."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Guilty of displacing enough people..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty of displacing enough people to cause refugee waves across the continent."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And even guilty of transporting th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And even guilty of transporting those refugees to Morella! A country that has nothing to do with Rizia's war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I got up from my seat and interrupt..."
entries.dialogueText: I got up from my seat and interrupted him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I let him continue."
entries.dialogueText: I let him continue.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lies! Slander!""
entries.dialogueText: "Lies! Slander!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not listen to this clown!""
entries.dialogueText: "Do not listen to this clown!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has a right to defend itself!""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has a right to defend itself!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our war in Pales is completely jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our war in Pales is completely justified. You are saying this only because of your interests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are conveniently forgetting yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are conveniently forgetting your own guilt, Alvarez!"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""President Nines!""
entries.dialogueText: "President Nines!"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I demand the continuation of my sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I demand the continuation of my speech!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd in the chamber roared lou..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd in the chamber roared louder. I heard some voices telling me to sit down and others telling me to go on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Nines hit the gavel many..."
entries.dialogueText: President Nines hit the gavel many times until there was silence.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Thank you. Now, where did I leave..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. Now, where did I leave off?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Ladies and gentlemen of the Allian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Alliance of Nations, we do not want war in Merkopa. We want peace."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""But that peace has been sabotaged..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that peace has been sabotaged by the archaic methods of this 'Kingdom'."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""They blocked independent journalis..."
entries.dialogueText: "They blocked independent journalists from entering their war zone so they could hide the truth. Pales is being destroyed before our eyes."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We have all read the headlines and..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have all read the headlines and watched the television broadcasts. We have seen the horrific images."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Are we expected to stand back and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are we expected to stand back and watch this humanitarian crisis unfold right before our eyes?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""They have murdered women and child..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have murdered women and children alike. They've burned villages, schools... Hospitals, for God's sake!"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""What they are doing should be comp..."
entries.dialogueText: "What they are doing should be completely obvious! This is a scorched earth policy."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Are we expected to be complicit in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are we expected to be complicit in these crimes against humanity?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I say... No!""
entries.dialogueText: "I say... No!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He hit the podium with a stack of p..."
entries.dialogueText: He hit the podium with a stack of papers.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Ladies and gentlemen. Leaders of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen. Leaders of the world!"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Lespia is hereby officially callin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia is hereby officially calling for heavy sanctions on this war-mongering nation. We ask anyone with a conscience to vote in favor of them."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The commotion in the hall grew even..."
entries.dialogueText: The commotion in the hall grew even louder as Alvarez left the stage.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This does not look good, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "This does not look good, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even if we get sanctioned, we will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if we get sanctioned, we will adapt and survive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rumburg won't let us down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg won't let us down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can say that again, Laurento.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can say that again, Laurento."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Look. It's starting.""
entries.dialogueText: "Look. It's starting."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I hope you are right.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are right."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""All who are in favor of sanctions..."
entries.dialogueText: "All who are in favor of sanctions on the Kingdom of Rizia, say 'Aye'. All opposed, say 'Nay'."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Thank you, President Nines.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, President Nines."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Ladies and gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at where Leon Malenyev wa..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at where Leon Malenyev was sitting.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""My comrades.""
entries.dialogueText: "My comrades."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""It has been brought to my attentio..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been brought to my attention that a certain country in Southern Merkopa is engaging in malicious actions with the intent of heavily destabilizing the region."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""My duty to the people of Valgsland..."
entries.dialogueText: "My duty to the people of Valgsland prevents me from being quiet against this injustice."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Against the tyranny of a so-called..."
entries.dialogueText: "Against the tyranny of a so-called 'Kingdom'. A remnant of the ugly past."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Kingdom of Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento and I looked at each other..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento and I looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A roar of outrage and confusion ros..."
entries.dialogueText: A roar of outrage and confusion rose in the chamber.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Son of a...""
entries.dialogueText: "Son of a..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As I expected.""
entries.dialogueText: "As I expected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Imagine stooping this low.""
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine stooping this low."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Please calm down, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please calm down, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As befits his position.""
entries.dialogueText: "As befits his position."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I cannot describe to you how disap..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot describe to you how disappointed I am that in this day and age, millions of people in Merkopa are still afflicted by the poison that is monarchy."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Rizians suffer under the iron..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizians suffer under the iron fist of a King. A man elected by no one, beholden to no one."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""He sits on his throne, reaping the..."
entries.dialogueText: "He sits on his throne, reaping the fruits of his citizen's labors."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Crushing them under the weight of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Crushing them under the weight of his menace. Not because he earned it. Because he was born to it."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""My ideological opposition to Mr. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "My ideological opposition to Mr. Toras' government is well known to all of you. But that is not what I am here to talk about today."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Rizia has been supporting a far-ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has been supporting a far-right nationalist organization, Su Omina, in its attempts to violently and underhandedly take over Zille."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I am here to talk about what they..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am here to talk about what they are doing to justify their vile existence."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Rizian troops have been brutally c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian troops have been brutally crushing a democratic uprising in the Confederacy of Vendonesam."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Rizia has been using excessive for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has been using excessive force to quell the peaceful protests of its own citizens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I got up from my seat and interrupt..."
entries.dialogueText: I got up from my seat and interrupted him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I let him continue."
entries.dialogueText: I let him continue.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lies! Slander!""
entries.dialogueText: "Lies! Slander!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Malenyev's lapdog!""
entries.dialogueText: "Malenyev's lapdog!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now I'm a tyrant? You were all too..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now I'm a tyrant? You were all too happy to cooperate with me when it meant screwing over Lespia, *comrade*."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia does not have to justify its..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia does not have to justify its actions!"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""President Nines!""
entries.dialogueText: "President Nines!"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""If you'd please let me continue!""
entries.dialogueText: "If you'd please let me continue!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd in the chamber roared lou..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd in the chamber roared louder. I heard some voices telling me to sit down and others telling me to go on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Nines hit the gavel many..."
entries.dialogueText: President Nines hit the gavel many times until there was silence.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The unfortunate plight of the Blud..."
entries.dialogueText: "The unfortunate plight of the Bludish people is known to us. But banning them from the border? That is inhumane at best."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Rizia has been helping to persecut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has been helping to persecute Wehlen's Bludish minority under the guise of an attack against the BFF."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Yes, we know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we know."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Many of you in this room may be un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many of you in this room may be unaware of Rizia's actions, thanks to the monarchy's merciless censorship of the media."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I know that some of you have even..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that some of you have even been bribed into participating in Rizian media campaigns."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""We know so much more.""
entries.dialogueText: "We know so much more."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But what I have just mentioned sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "But what I have just mentioned should be enough to incriminate the Kingdom of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""And I call upon my fellow world le..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I call upon my fellow world leaders to pass official sanctions on Rizia. Heavy ones."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Our motto has not changed. 'Throug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our motto has not changed. 'Through broken shackles'. So I call upon you all."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I call upon the people of Rizia to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I call upon the people of Rizia to free themselves from their oppressors and break their shackles."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The commotion grew louder than ever..."
entries.dialogueText: The commotion grew louder than ever as Hegel left the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ayes and Nays followed from differe..."
entries.dialogueText: Ayes and Nays followed from different directions. With every Aye, I winced.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Abstain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Abstain."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Aye.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aye."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."
